name: taxappeal-escalate
description: ClaimOS Escalate step ("Appeal again"): reads the county's decision and decides the next move, fully automatically

scripts.demo: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out/demo-results.json',{force:true})" && tsx scripts/make-samples.ts && tsx src/cli.ts run --cases data/cases.sample.json --decisions data/decisions.sample.json --config config/escalate.placeholder.json --today 2026-11-05 --llm mock --out out/demo-results.json --audit out/demo-audit.jsonl && tsx src/cli.ts cases --results out/demo-results.json --export out/demo-cases.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run demo
scripts.bundle:agent: npx --yes esbuild@0.24.0 src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist-agent/taxappeal-escalate/escalate.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('config','dist-agent/taxappeal-escalate/config',{recursive:true})"
